latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Free Video Generator HD skill.
- Generate HD 1080p videos from text or images and export as MP4.
- Supports JPG, PNG, MP4, MOV uploads up to 200MB; processing takes 1–2 minutes.
- Built-in free token system: 100 credits for 7 days for new users.
- Offers easy file uploads, session-based editing, and cloud GPU rendering — no software install needed.
- Action mapping for commands like export, upload, credits, and status; supports prompt-based workflows.
